messages:
emma_support: Hi team — Customer Cust-504 reporting their embeddings output width changed after they pinned a variant yesterday. They expected 1024 but some responses are 1536. Hitting support now, escalated by AM. @lina_oncall can you take first look?

cust-504-ops: Confirmed. No errors, just different vector length intermittently. Some calls return 1024, others 1536 for same input. Happens more when we send batches of 8+. We pinned to 'rwd-embed-large:v2-lock-2026' last night.

samir_engineer: Thanks — can you paste a minimal repro request and one raw response? Also which model id and variant digest are you actually using (not alias)?

cust-504-ops: repro curl below — we call the /embeddings endpoint.

```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "rwd-embed-large:v2-lock-2026",
    "input": ["test sentence 1","test sentence 2","test sentence 3","test sentence 4","test sentence 5","test sentence 6","test sentence 7","test sentence 8"]
  }'
```

Raw snippet (redacted):
```
{"data":[{"embedding":[0.001,...],"index":0},{"embedding":[0.002,...],"index":1},{"embedding":[0.003,...],"index":2}]}
```

samir_engineer: Can you show exact lengths for the first response items? e.g., len(embedding[0]) and len(embedding[1])

cust-504-ops: lengths we logged: [1024, 1536, 1536, 1024, 1536, 1536, 1024, 1536] — so it's not a full flip, it's per-request/batch dependent.

lina_oncall: That's odd. Two immediate checks: 1) Are you going through a cached routing rule that might be redirecting some shards to an alias (variant mix)? 2) Are you using any client-side batching or retry that could switch model param between chunked calls?

cust-504-ops: No client retries. Single curl. All requests go to our single endpoint. We do have a reserved capacity reservation and pinned variant in the console.

samir_engineer: @lina_oncall please run a quick variant->digest mapping for that alias. On infra side, I'll grep the logs for the serving nodes that handled the timestamps the customer provided.

sre-bot: deploy: variant-mapping-check job started for rwd-embed-large:v2-lock-2026

samir_engineer: Found a routing history entry where alias 'rwd-embed-large:v2-lock-2026' mapped to two digest ids over the last 12h: digest A (embed_dim=1024) then digest B (embed_dim=1536). Looks like an accidental alias update during a model rollout.

emma_support: So alias mutation caused mixed responses. Does the customer pin to alias rather than immutable digest?

cust-504-ops: We thought the pinned name was immutable. We pinned in the console to the named variant.

josh_product: Quick context — alias pins in console can be turned into an immutable reservation, but there is a difference between 'name lock' and 'digest lock'. The onboarding UI doc warned about this but engineer workflows have caused confusion. Sorry for the surprise.

lina_oncall: Immediate mitigations: 1) For the customer, re-route their reserved endpoint to the digest that gave 1024 (rollback to digest A) to restore previous shape. 2) Block the alias update and mark as incident. 3) We'll add a temporary check in the serving layer to assert embedding dimension matches the model metadata and reject responses that don't match.

samir_engineer: For repro, I ran an internal curl against both digests:
```
# digest A (sha:aaa111) -> embedding length 1024
# digest B (sha:bbb222) -> embedding length 1536
```

Command: `curl -sS -X POST https://internal-serving/v1/embeddings -d '{"model_digest":"aaa111","input":["x"]}'` -> returns len 1024. Replacing digest with bbb222 returns 1536.

cust-504-ops: Can you remap us to digest aaa111 now? We have 40k docs that would break similarity scoring otherwise.

emma_support: Setting priority: P1 for customer impact. I'll request a manual remap to digest aaa111 and notify billing/CS about remediation. Also advise customer on re-embedding plan if they want to move forward with new model shape.

josh_product: Longer-term action items: 1) prevent alias updates that change output schema without explicit notif/consent; 2) surface embedding_dim in the UI and API responses; 3) require digest-lock for reserved capacity by default; 4) migration tooling to re-embed corpora when customers opt-in. I'll file a product ticket.

samir_engineer: Tech follow-ups for eng-runtime: add a runtime assertion that compares model metadata.embedding_dim vs response length. If mismatch, mark the response failed and route to fallback variant. Also add an alert if alias updates change critical fields.

lina_oncall: Ops did the remap to digest aaa111 for the customer's reservation at 11:08 PDT. Confirmed responses now consistently 1024. We issued a one-hour incident window and notified the customer.

cust-504-ops: Confirmed on our side — embeddings now all 1024 for the same batch. Thanks. We need guidance on re-embedding strategy and whether costs will be credited for forced re-runs.

emma_support: Logged a billing follow-up with finance and CS. For now offer the customer free re-embeddings script (small python snippet) and a short credit while we finalize policy.

samir_engineer: Snippet for safe re-embedding with explicit digest binding:
```
import requests
headers = {"Authorization":"Bearer $KEY","Content-Type":"application/json"}
payload = {"model_digest":"aaa111","input":[...]} 
requests.post("https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings", json=payload, headers=headers)
```

josh_product: I'll update the console copy to make 'digest lock' the recommended default and add a tooltip about embedding dimensions. Also scheduling a postmortem to tighten onboarding docs.

emma_support: Resolved for customer: remapped -> verified -> offered remediation plan. Keeping thread open until product ticket lands. :white_check_mark:

sre-bot: incident: alias-update-unexpected-dim logged as INC-2026-112, assigned to eng-runtime and product.

lina_oncall: Adding one more note — we'll also add a gate in rollout CI to prevent alias rollouts when metadata.embedding_dim differs unless explicit override is set.

cust-504-ops: Appreciate the fast turnaround. Please keep us in the loop on the migration plan and credits.

emma_support: Will do. Closing customer-facing loop in 24h after formal remediate plan is posted. :handshake:
